Chapter 57

Guanghe sixth year, December.

In Luoyang City, the North Palace is not a palace.

At this moment, in this resplendent and extravagant solemn palace, the master of the Great Han Empire, Hanling Emperor Liu Hong was sitting high on his emperor tower.

Looking from afar, Liu Hong was wearing a black and red imperial suit, with a twelve-pronged black imperial crown on his head. His face was blocked by a hanging bead curtain, and he couldn't see clearly, but his complexion looked very white, and his body It seems that there are some diseases.

However, even if his body was a little weak, as the master of the Han Empire, he dared not let anyone ignore his words and deeds.

Hundreds of ministers of civil and military affairs stood on the left and right of the seat, all dressed in majestic and heavy official uniforms, neatly arranged in two rows, and lined up neatly according to their respective official positions.

"Let's talk about it, what should we do? It's just a few months, and in the blink of an eye, most of Yizhou has been lost, and even his prefecture CD, a powerful city with a population of hundreds of thousands, was destroyed within ten days. Even the ability to support for more than ten days and wait for reinforcements is not enough!"

Liu Hong's angry voice spread throughout the hall.

"Your Majesty, why do you need to worry? It's nothing more than a mere rebel, and I guess it's just a mob, so why worry about it? As long as my court sends a general to lead the court's elite army to Yizhou to gather local county soldiers, peace will surely be achieved within a few months." At this time, the three princes of the imperial court, the Taiwei Chen Wen who was in charge of the military, said in response.

"Then you can be recommended by someone, and you can relieve this disaster for me." Hearing Chen Wen's words, Liu Hong calmed down his anger a little and asked aloud.

"Huang Fusong, the governor of Beidi County, is a stable man, knows military affairs, and often has great ideas and quick thinking, so he can take on this great job." Hearing Emperor Ling's question, Chen Wen confidently spoke out the candidate he had already determined in his mind.

"What do you all think? Can Huangfu Song take up this important role?" Hearing Chen Wen's answer, Liu Hong was not in a hurry to make a decision, but instead asked many ministers in the court. After all, soldiers are important to the country. inspect.

"Huangfu Song was born as a general in the past dynasties. He is familiar with military affairs and has a strategy in his chest. He can be a general." Sikong and Yuan Kai also came out to support him. Opportunity to speak.

"Huangfusong leads troops to guard the northern land all the year round, and has repeatedly confronted the Xiongnu Xianbei and many barbarians. If he has a strategy, he can be a general." The general He Jin, who very much hoped to establish relationships with aristocratic families so as to get rid of his butcher background, hurriedly responded. attached.

"The ministers and others seconded the proposal!" Then there was a voice of agreement, and many officials of the court agreed with Taiwei Chen Wen's opinion.

Seeing that the Korean, Chinese and military officials all agreed, Liu Hong still looked at the regular servants beside him, wanting to see how they viewed it.

"Your Majesty, this servant thinks that Huangfusong, the Governor of Beidi County, can take on this great job!" said Lu Qiang, the Zhongchang servant who had higher political wisdom and was more upright among the many regular servants.

Then the other regular attendants saw Lu Qiang's words, considering that Huangfusong was indeed a talent, they could quell this judgment, and they didn't want to take Lu Qiang's face too far, so they nodded in agreement.

"Well, summon Huangfusong, the governor of Beidi County, to the capital, accept the seal, prepare the military, and set out to fight against rebellion." Seeing that both officials and eunuchs at home and abroad believed that Huangfusong could crusade against rebellion, he readily agreed their suggestions.

"Now that the candidates for the expedition have been decided, let's discuss how to arrange the vacant Beidi prefect and the officials of the counties and counties in Yizhou." I asked again about the buying and selling of officials.

"Your Majesty, my nephew, Yuan Shaoke, is the governor of Beidi." It was Sikong Yuanwei who said this.

"Your Majesty, the imperial envoy Liu Yan can be the governor of Yizhou." It was Sikong Liu Yu who said this.

"His Majesty……"

All of a sudden, there was a commotion in the main hall, and you came and went to fight for the places of those officials, wanting to use them to install your party members.

The day's government affairs came to an end amidst the uproar, and the senior officials in the court were all satisfied and returned to their homes. Obviously, those people have arranged their own party members in various places, and they did not return empty-handed.

Half a month later, after receiving the emperor's order, Huang Fusong, the governor of Beidi County, hurriedly handed over his official seal, and hurried back to Luoyang with the angel who read out the imperial decree.

After resting for one night, after bathing and changing clothes, he entered the palace to meet the emperor. After some in-depth talks, he left the palace and entered the military camp with the tiger charm bestowed by the emperor.

Qualified soldiers were drawn out one by one to form an army of 30,000 in total. These people will train in Luoyang for three months, and when the ice and snow fade away and the weather is no longer so cold, they will go to Yizhou to fight against the rebels with the local county soldiers.

At this time, Zhong Yu, after breaking through CD City, used the total of 4,000 luck points he had obtained before to summon scribes at all levels to fill in the counties and counties where there were vacancies for officials.

Some generals were also summoned. For the Three Kingdoms game, they are generals whose military commanders are over 70 or 80. Those below 70 will not be described, and those above 80 are four of them, namely Wang Fang, Li Zhen, Han Kai, and Zhao Ping, who have commanded fierce generals over 80. Each of them will assign 5,000 troops to them. They crusade against the four counties of Guanghan County, Hanjia County, Wenshan County, and Qianwei County surrounding Shu County.

After a month of fighting around, the lost counties of Shu County and Guanghan County have been completely pacified, and the four generals have also completely captured the counties they attacked and brought them under their command.

At this time, Huangfusong had just arrived in Luoyang, ready to train his soldiers and horses before attacking Zhong Yu.

In the emperor's palace in CD City, Zhong Yu and his subordinates, Wen and Wu, were sitting in the political hall, discussing the next strategy together.

At this time, after a month of fighting, Zhong Yu had obtained about 20,000 elite soldiers. These soldiers could be said to be first-class in the entire Han Dynasty. They belonged to the imperial capital and helped the emperor to dominate the world strength.

In addition to these elite soldiers, 200,000 cannon fodder troops were drawn from the newly occupied six counties under his command, ready to be used in the next siege.

At this time, Zhong Yu had only one Yinping County in the north of Yizhou that was not under the rule. In the eastern part of Yizhou, there are five counties including Brazil County, Badong County, Berkshire County, FL County, and Jiangyou County, which are not under the rule. Since the southern part of Yizhou is mostly wild and full of miasma, it has not been involved yet. The six counties in the west have already been occupied by themselves.

After discussions between Zhong Yu and the generals, it was decided to divide the troops into four routes, one led by Wang Fang, who led 3,000 elite soldiers, and the 30,000 cannon fodder army entered Yunnan County, Yizhou County, and finally Yongchang County.

Led by Li Zhen, he led 5,000 elite soldiers and 50,000 cannon fodder troops, from Zhudi County to Zangke County, Jianning County, and finally to Xinggu County. The two armies and horses cooperated with each other to pacify the southern part of Yizhou.

The first road was led by Zhao Ping, who led 5,000 elite soldiers into Yinping County, and then moved to Hanzhong. In order to prevent the imperial army from attacking Yizhou from the north.

In the end, Zhong Yu and Han Kai led 3,000 system soldiers, 7,000 elite soldiers, and 120,000 cannon fodder troops to attack the five counties in the west of Yizhou.

Blooming in all directions like this, strive to pacify the entire Yizhou within three months.
